Flutter iOS engine headers
Compile the bridge sources for iOS arm64
Bridge, session and preparation identity contracts

pack: Loaded iPhoneOS metallib and reflection from S2ALIB using the engine reader
PASS matching/stale/unlisted translated stages, persisted executable shader, GPU output 12, absent and damaged binaries
registration: PASS docs/wire shader-disk, Fair registered compute program to observed worker, Metal library and PSO built
PASS registration and extended registration build Metal libraries before commands, keep mutable guest keys independent, and capture compiler inputs
PASS disabled registration leaves preparation until the recorded bind
twoPhasePrewarm: ✓ cold workers did not start while a hot worker is held
✓ startup workers execute at userInitiated and cold workers at utility
✓ cold file opened after hot completion and duplicate suppressed
liveLane: PASS required PSO completes on the live lane while both observed workers are held
lookahead: PASS cumulative lookahead deadline, retry cap, publication epochs and collisions
firstDraw: PASS MRT material over an existing depth prepass is eligible
PASS missing library returns while both workers are gated
PASS fourth frame still within budget
PASS fifth frame requires the exact path
PASS four real omissions, zero submit source builds and zero waits
PASS frame 200 omitted exactly one library draw
PASS frame 200 returned before the compiler owner was released
PASS frame 200 expected red 0.00 on eight pixels, mismatches=0
PASS both distinct libraries compiled off-submit
PASS frame 201 consumed the finished pipeline without waiting
PASS frame 201 expected red 0.25 on eight pixels, mismatches=0
PASS frame 202 omitted exactly one PSO draw
PASS frame 202 returned before the compiler owner was released
PASS frame 202 expected red 0.00 on eight pixels, mismatches=0
PASS frame 203 consumed the finished pipeline without waiting

archiveMigration: scoped archive strict legacy hit, promotion, reopen and title/build isolation passed

limitations: Mac GPU fixtures and iOS arm64 compilation. No post-change A18 Pro capture of either title.
Lookup timing covers a preopened archive on the Mac and excludes pipeline creation.
The UBO readback used the tracked Metal encoder on the hosted Mac. Opaque ordered updates retained their compatibility encoder split.
Runtime MSL remains possible on an uncaptured stage or variant; the Mac producer writes executable AIR and iOS writes binary pipeline archives.
